agent_note: Third-person present-tense narration following Lydia and Luca; 29 present / 4 past across 33 event quotes (87.9% present). The entire past minority is backstory/recollection - bookshop-and-baby backstory (q04320), a past-perfect hope (q04326), habitual past reading (q04345), and past exposition on a cartel figure (q04346) - so this is a clean present + recollection strand rather than an unexplained split. Unusually heavy paratext leakage: 7 quotes are author's note or acknowledgments, four of them self-labelled on the Goodreads page. Quotation marks survive on the true dialogue quotes, so mark-majority was the deciding signal there. Two abstentions: q04336 (first-person past in a third-person novel, speech vs author's note undecidable) and q04343 (embedded verse).
